answer_1.quote: We use a T5 model as the basis of our logical form generator ... the input for KBs is formatted as: [X; <|second_hop|> primitives ; <|first_hop|> primitives]. ... The generator learns to generate logical forms by understanding the meaning of its elements‑primitives and operations ‑ and composing them.

answer_2.quote: We use their official evaluation script for each dataset with two metrics to measure logical form of program exact match accuracy (EM) and answer accuracy (F1).
